hard_cases.name: Otter AI
hard_cases.reason: Pass 1 agent hallucinated an official public REST API. Human review confirmed no public developer program exists; community MCP tools reverse-engineer user session cookies (auth_token), which break on UI logout.

hard_cases.name: NotebookLM
hard_cases.reason: Sharp separation between the consumer app (zero public API) and Google Cloud Vertex AI Discovery Engine APIs. Pass 1 agent claimed standard API key access; human review caught enterprise GCP prerequisite.

hard_cases.name: fanbasis
hard_cases.reason: Agent correctly classified this platform as Blocked (No API) with zero public developer endpoints. Integration is hard because toolkit creation strictly requires browser-use automation.

hard_cases.name: PitchBook
hard_cases.reason: Agent correctly classified platform as Gated / Partner Required. Verification was hard because developer docs are shielded by Cloudflare Enterprise WAF (HTTP 403 on CLI) and pricing is undisclosed institutional sales.
